title: 三的倍数份披萨
summary: 环形披萨有 3n 块，每轮选择一块后相邻两块被他人拿走，求自己选 n 块可获得的最大总和。
insight: 等价于环上选择 n 个互不相邻元素。环形约束拆成不选末块与不选首块两个线性问题，每个用恰选 j 个非相邻元素的动态规划。
pitfalls: 必须恰好选择总长度三分之一块
首尾相邻，需拆为两个线性区间
不可达的 DP 状态要设为负无穷

solutions.title: 两段线性不相邻动态规划
solutions.idea: 分别排除环首或环尾并求线性最优。
steps: solve(start,end)：dp[i][j] 表示前 i 项恰选 j 项最大和，转移跳过或从 i-2 取

code.java: class Solution { private int solve(int[] slices,int start,int end,int picks){int length=end-start+1,negative=-1_000_000_000;int[][] dp=new int[length+1][picks+1];for(int[] row:dp)Arrays.fill(row,negative);for(int i=0;i<=length;i++)dp[i][0]=0;for(int i=1;i<=length;i++)for(int chosen=1;chosen<=picks;chosen++){dp[i][chosen]=dp[i-1][chosen];int previous=dp[Math.max(0,i-2)][chosen-1];if(previous!=negative)dp[i][chosen]=Math.max(dp[i][chosen],previous+slices[start+i-1]);}return dp[length][picks];}public int maxSizeSlices(int[] slices){int picks=slices.length/3;return Math.max(solve(slices,0,slices.length-2,picks),solve(slices,1,slices.length-1,picks));} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private fun solve(slices:IntArray,start:Int,end:Int,picks:Int):Int{val length=end-start+1;val negative=-1_000_000_000;val dp=Array(length+1){IntArray(picks+1){negative}};for(i in 0..length)dp[i][0]=0;for(i in 1..length)for(chosen in 1..picks){dp[i][chosen]=dp[i-1][chosen];val previous=dp[maxOf(0,i-2)][chosen-1];if(previous!=negative)dp[i][chosen]=maxOf(dp[i][chosen],previous+slices[start+i-1])};return dp[length][picks]};fun maxSizeSlices(slices:IntArray):Int{val picks=slices.size/3;return maxOf(solve(slices,0,slices.size-2,picks),solve(slices,1,slices.size-1,picks))} }
code.cpp: class Solution { int solve(vector<int>& slices,int start,int end,int picks){int length=end-start+1,negative=-1000000000;vector<vector<int>> dp(length+1,vector<int>(picks+1,negative));for(int i=0;i<=length;++i)dp[i][0]=0;for(int i=1;i<=length;++i)for(int chosen=1;chosen<=picks;++chosen){dp[i][chosen]=dp[i-1][chosen];int previous=dp[max(0,i-2)][chosen-1];if(previous!=negative)dp[i][chosen]=max(dp[i][chosen],previous+slices[start+i-1]);}return dp[length][picks];}public:int maxSizeSlices(vector<int>& slices){int picks=slices.size()/3;return max(solve(slices,0,slices.size()-2,picks),solve(slices,1,slices.size()-1,picks));} };
